Bodegas Ateca

Atteca

RedDesignation of Origin (DO) Calatayud

High-altitude old-vine Garnacha from Bodegas Ateca in the Calatayud D.O., aged in barrel.

Atteca is the wine that gives its name to Bodegas Ateca's main range. It is made from old bush-trained Garnacha vines around Ateca, in the Jalón valley, within the Calatayud D.O. The vineyards lie at high altitude, on poor soils of slate, stones and limestone.

The extreme continental climate, with cool nights even in summer, allows Garnacha to ripen without entirely losing its acidity. The wine is aged in oak barrels for several months, which adds structure and spicy notes. It is a concentrated, ripe Garnacha with freshness, a good representative of the high-altitude reds of Calatayud.

It can be enjoyed on release, although it usually gains in harmony with a few years of cellaring in good conditions; airing it for a few minutes before serving helps it express itself better.

Tasting profile

Ripe black and red fruit, notes of wild herbs, spice and a mineral background. Full-bodied palate with ripe tannins and a long finish.

Food pairing

Lamb, chargrilled red meats, stews, aged cheeses

Serving

16-18 °C, large glass
